ORIGIN_n.question: What must be frozen and independently instantiated before A/B coding can legitimately feed the blinded scorer?
open_gaps: identical packet version/hash for both coders
hypothesis_set: H1: two genuinely independent coders reduce single-analyst idiosyncrasy
H2: two coders alone are insufficient if arbitration or packet instructions can drift after disagreements are visible
H3: translation-only controls can create false lexical matches unless lexical evidence is source-language grounded

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Arbitration rules were not yet frozen before coder outputs.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.why_reverse_found_it: Tracing backward from a valid frozen matrix shows that every disagreement resolution must itself be governed by rules fixed before disagreements are observed.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: Freeze ARBITRATION_PROTOCOL.v0.1 before issuing A/B packets.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Coder independence was stated but not yet receipted as an operational property.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.why_reverse_found_it: A matrix labeled double-coded is not independent merely because it has columns A and B.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: Require separate coder-instance receipts, no shared outputs, no copy/replay lineage, and no same reasoning instance represented twice.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: The coder instruction packet itself needs an immutable version/hash before either coder begins.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.why_reverse_found_it: Otherwise A and B can unknowingly receive different ontology or evidence rules and disagreement becomes uninterpretable.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: Freeze SOURCE_CODING_PACKET_TEMPLATE.v0.1 and bind every coding receipt to its SHA-256.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Independent coders do not make translation vocabulary independent evidence.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.why_reverse_found_it: A scorer result containing lexical similarity requires source-language support upstream, not agreement between coders on an English gloss.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: rare_lexical_or_formulaic_correspondence may be PRESENT only with original-language or philologically controlled evidence; otherwise UNKNOWN, never inferred from shared English wording.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Arbitration must remain blind to downstream score, control class and target-family role.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.why_reverse_found_it: An arbitrator who knows which resolution improves the expected cluster can reintroduce post-hoc tuning after independent coding.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: Arbitrator sees source locus, frozen feature definition and both coder evidence packets, but no scorer output, opaque mapping reveal, control class or expected cluster.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: The project can advance without pretending to have coder B by freezing every pre-coder contract and packet now.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.why_reverse_found_it: The missing independent coder is localized to semantic judgments, not to protocol, packet, arbitration, hashing or leakage infrastructure.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: Advance to PRE_CODER_CONTRACTS_FROZEN while leaving all semantic feature cells UNCODED.

required_preconditions_reverse_order: leakage validator PASS on scorer-facing packets
opaque scorer packets frozen with no forbidden metadata
C09/C10 generated only after double-coded arbitrated matrix freeze
every disagreement has a pre-rule-compliant arbitration receipt
A and B coding receipts exist for every F01-F05 and C01-C08 item
A and B are operationally independent and bound to the same packet-template hash
arbitration protocol, feature schema, source slices and controls were frozen before either coder output

FORWARD_PASS.preservation_rule: This forward chain is not rewritten after reverse findings; the new missing nodes are inserted by ORIGIN_PRIME state enrichment.

D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.FORWARD: source slice -> coding -> arbitration -> matrix -> nulls -> packets -> score
D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.BACK: score validity -> leakage-free packets -> post-matrix nulls -> frozen matrix -> pre-frozen arbitration -> genuinely independent coding -> immutable source slice

D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.LEFT: Coder A is an independent observation path.
D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.RIGHT: Coder B must be a genuinely separate observation path, not a replay, paraphrase, second prompt or same-instance role-play.
D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.mirror_requirement: Both paths use the same frozen feature definitions and source slice identity while remaining isolated from each other's decisions.

D3_ABSTRACTION_HIERARCHY.ASCEND: Agreement is a measurement-quality property, not truth authority.
D3_ABSTRACTION_HIERARCHY.DIVE: Every one of 28 feature cells requires a categorical value plus evidence pointer or explicit UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE reason.

D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC.EXPAND: Consider alternative readings, damaged text, translation ambiguity and ontology mismatch.
D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC.CONTRACT: Only the frozen feature definition and cited source locus can determine the recorded value.

D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.CLAIM_TO_SOURCE: Every PRESENT/ABSENT judgment must trace to an exact frozen locus or explicit philological support receipt.
D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.SOURCE_TO_CLAIM: Source wording may populate a feature value but cannot independently promote transmission, revelation or metaphysical interpretation.

MIRROR_DELTA.forward_claim: Independent double coding is authorized now.
MIRROR_DELTA.reverse_observation: Authorization is incomplete until arbitration, packet identity and coder-independence contracts are frozen before outputs.
MIRROR_DELTA.what_changed: The next legal action is narrowed from BEGIN_CODING to FREEZE_PRE_CODER_CONTRACTS_THEN_BEGIN_CODING.
MIRROR_DELTA.next_test: Validate that all pre-coder contracts are frozen and hash-addressed before accepting the first semantic coding cell.

MIRROR_DELTA.reverse_observation: Column labels do not establish independence.
MIRROR_DELTA.what_changed: Independence becomes an evidence-bearing receipt with operational conditions.
MIRROR_DELTA.next_test: Reject any A/B pair sharing the same reasoning instance, copied output, exposed counterpart decisions or non-independent lineage.

MIRROR_DELTA.forward_claim: Disagreements can be arbitrated after coding.
MIRROR_DELTA.reverse_observation: Post-output arbitration rules create analyst degrees of freedom.
MIRROR_DELTA.what_changed: Arbitration is moved before coding as a frozen protocol while actual decisions remain after A/B receipts exist.
MIRROR_DELTA.next_test: No arbitration outcome is admissible unless it conforms to the pre-output protocol hash.
